headline: How long am I going to be alone?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The pictures were hidden, but your hand went to the one who came ready.
Every tool he needs is laid out across the table.
You asked how long you are going to be alone. The ready table is the part I keep coming back to.
Nobody has come, and the waiting is long enough for you to ask for a number.
Whatever keeps connection away does so without disturbing your readiness. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what is holding this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs were alike, yet you reached for the card held at one point.
One rope holds one ankle. The rest of him hangs loose.
You asked for the length of the waiting. This card makes me look at the one point carrying the pause.
Still, you are alone, and the length of the pause is the question.
Something reaches the question right where waiting would become a meeting. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what that obstruction is…
c: You turned the Fool. You couldn't see him, but your hand found the one at the beginning.
The small bundle on his stick is all he has packed.
You asked how long being alone will last. The beginning on this card catches my attention.
But no one is moving with you, and you are asking how long that continues.
Something sits between the beginning and connection. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
